battle.name: 唐滅薛延陀之戰
battle.theater: 蒙古高原郁督軍山一帶
battle.brief: 貞觀十九年冬，薛延陀多彌可汗拔灼趁唐太宗東征高句麗，屢攻夏州。太宗發朔州、勝州、靈州諸兵分道進討，李道宗、阿史那社爾任瀚海安撫大使，執失思力與契苾何力各率胡兵，直指蒙古高原。拔灼敗走為回紇所殺，李世勣至郁督軍山招降咄摩支，薛延陀汗國遂亡；月牙劍一類單刃彎刀正是騎兵貼身近戰的兵器。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 交戰一方是唐太宗治下的唐朝，另一方是漠北的薛延陀汗國。薛延陀出自敕勒（鐵勒）諸部，627年趁東突厥內亂脫離，628年由首領乙失夷男自立真珠毗伽可汗；630年李靖滅東突厥之後，東突厥部眾與牧地大半歸薛延陀所聚，它遂成草原霸主，名義上仍稱臣於唐。另一方是唐廷自貞觀初年組成的北討體系：李世勣、張儉、李大亮、張士貴、李襲譽各道兵馬，李道宗與阿史那社爾任瀚海安撫大使總攬大軍，執失思力率歸附突厥兵、契苾何力率涼州及胡兵、薛萬徹與營州都督張儉各將所部，並以朔州、勝州、靈州三處州兵據守要衝，形成步步為營的縱深。薛延陀內部也非鐵板一塊：回紇首領藥羅葛吐迷度、僕骨、同羅等附庸相繼倒戈，堂兄咄摩支更以伊特勿失可汗名號收拾殘部，向唐請降。
countriesEn: Two sides fought this war: the Tang court under Emperor Taizong on one, the Xueyantuo Khanate of the northern steppe on the other. Xueyantuo had risen out of the Jiehe or Tiele confederation, breaking away from the Eastern Turks amid their civil strife in 627, and in 628 its leader Yishi Yiman proclaimed himself Zhenzhu Pijia Khagan. After Li Jing destroyed the Eastern Turkic Khaganate in 630, most of the Eastern Turkic people and their pastures passed to Xueyantuo, which became the dominant power of the steppe while still professing submission to Tang. The other side was the northern expeditionary apparatus Tang had built since the opening of the Zhenguan era: Li Shiji, Zhang Jian, Li Daliang, Zhang Shigui and Li Xiyu each led troops out of their own circuits; Li Daozong and Ashina She'er served as Pacification Commissioners for the Hanhai and took overall charge of the main army; Zhishi Siri commanded surrendered Turkic soldiers, Qibi Heli the Liangzhou and Hu troops, and Xue Wanche and Camp Commandant Zhang Jian their own contingents, while troops of the circuits were posted at three anchor points — Shuozhou, Shengzhou and Lingzhou — forming a deep, step-by-step line of advance. Xueyantuo itself was no solid block: the Uighur chief Yiluoge Tumidu and the Pugu and Tongaou vassal tribes deserted in turn, and the cousin Duomozhi, styling himself Yite Wushi Khagan, gathered the remnants and sued for submission to Tang.
people: 唐太宗李世民是整場戰爭的樞紐：641年冊封阿史那思摩為俟力苾可汗、定襄設東突厥故地，本為在薛延陀與唐之間插入緩衝；諾真水交兵後他一度欲發兵窮討薛延陀，經魏徵力諫才止。642至643年他以聘禮未足為由反悔與真珠可汗的和親，褚遂良力諫反對，仍收回成命，宗室女終未嫁出，這是雙方互信崩解的關鍵。名將方面，李世勣於641年大破大度設，646年率軍至郁督軍山討咄摩支，傳令「降則撫之，叛則討之」，並遣通事舍人蕭嗣業往招；執失思力與田仁會在夏州設伏破拔灼；契苾何力被薛延陀扣押，割左耳以明歸唐之志；喬師望與執失思力合兵追擊拔灼；出使烏羅護、靺鞨的唐校尉宇文法率靺鞨兵擊敗薛延陀阿波設，一度使薛延陀人誤以為唐軍主力已到。薛延陀方面，真珠可汗乙失夷男於645年病卒，庶子曳莽與正妻所生之子拔灼交惡，被拔灼追殺；拔灼即位為多彌可汗，誅戮舊臣、猜忌多疑，引起部眾離心；最終咄摩支降唐，授右武衛大將軍，回紇吐迷度則襲殺拔灼。
peopleEn: Emperor Taizong of Tang is the pivot of the whole affair. In 641 he invested Ashina Simo as the Hilibi Khagan and settled him at Dingxiang on the site of the former Eastern Turkic state, precisely in order to wedge a buffer between Xueyantuo and Tang; after the clash at Nozhenshui he was on the point of pursuing the Xueyantuo to the utter end and was stopped only by Wei Zheng's remonstrance. Between 642 and 643 he cancelled the marriage alliance with Zhenzhu Khagan on the pretext that the betrothal gifts were insufficient; Chu Suiliang strongly objected, yet the promise was still withdrawn and the Tang princess was never given away, and that was the moment the mutual trust of the two sides collapsed. Among the generals, Li Shiji defeated Dadu She in 641 and in 646 marched to the Yudu Jun Mountains against Duomozhi, ordering that those who surrender be pacified and those who rebel be chastised, and sending the Gentleman of the Household Xiao Siye to make overtures. Zhishi Siri and Tian Renhui ambushed Ba Zhuo at Xiazhou; Qibi Heli, detained by Xueyantuo, cut off his own left ear to swear his loyalty to Tang; Qiao Shiwang and Zhishi Siri pursued Ba Zhuo together; and the Tang colonel Yu Wenfa, envoy to the Wuhuanhu and the Mohe, beat the Xueyantuo Abu She with Mohe soldiers, briefly convincing the Xueyantuo that the main Tang army had arrived. On the other side, Zhenzhu Khagan Yishi Yiman died of illness in 645, and the harsh treatment meted out by the successor was a sign of the regime's disintegration. Ba Zhuo, the son born of the principal wife, chased down and killed his half-brother Yimang, took the throne as Duomi Khagan, slaughtered his father's old ministers out of suspicion and irritability, and drove the tribal lords into dissidence. In the end Duomozhi surrendered to Tang and was granted the post of Commander of the Right Imperial Guard, while the Uighur Tumidu stabbed Ba Zhuo in the back.
kits: 卡面兵器是埃及月牙劍（Khopesh），約公元前1500年起見於埃及中王國晚期，銅質外彎單刃，刃脊作曲角，劈入人身或盾面之後可順勢拉出而無須拔刃，主要用於陣前貼身搏鬥。它並不屬於645年蒙古高原的裝備體系，卻與草原上的短彎刀屬於同一功能譜系：薩卡、塞種的短彎刀與匈奴、突厥騎兵所佩馬刀同樣弧刃、便於拉砍，缺點是厚背、弧度大而穿刺力弱，適合砍劈而非直刺，也因此常與複合反曲弓配合使用。唐軍近戰主力是環首刀與直刃長刀，配長柄矛、槊，裝備明光鎧、札甲、兜鍪；步卒以十字弩、擲裝弩為主，騎兵用單臂小弩，並備長槊對付衝鋒的騎隊。薛延陀與突厥騎兵幾乎全靠馬弓箭，配短刀、矛與骨鏃長槊，多著皮甲或札甲，缺乏攻城器械與長於攻城的技術。馬是雙方根本：薛延陀一人數馬，輪換乘騎以便連續追擊；唐軍自內地徵馬，並以牛、騾馱運糧秣，靠驛道與河谷分批北送。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Egyptian khopesh, attested from about 1500 BCE in late Middle Kingdom Egypt: a bronze blade with a strongly outward curve and a single edge, whose back hooks over so that a stroke into a body or a shield can be pulled back out without reversing the cut, the weapon of close combat at the moment of contact. It does not belong to the equipment system of the Mongolian plateau in 645, yet it sits in the same functional family as the short curved sabres of the steppe: the Saka and Scythian blades and the sabres carried by Xiongnu and Turkic horsemen are likewise single-edged and curved for hooking and slashing, their drawback being a thick spine and a deep arc that gives up piercing power in favour of chopping, which is why they were habitually paired with the composite bow. The Tang close-combat core was the ring-pommel dao and the straight single-edged long sword, backed by long-handled spears and lances, with bright plate cuirasses, lamellar armour and helmets. The foot line fought with crossbows, both the large spanning type and the compact thrower, while mounted troops carried small one-handed bows and long lances to answer enemy cavalry charges. The Xueyantuo and other Turkic riders depended almost entirely on the horse and the bow, armed with short knives, spears and bone-tipped lances, wearing mostly leather or lamellar armour, and they possessed neither siege engines nor the skill to conduct a siege. Horses were the foundation for both sides: a Xueyantuo warrior might own several mounts and ride them in rotation so as to keep up a pursuit, while the Tang drew horses from the interior provinces and moved grain and fodder north by ox and mule in relays along the post roads and river valleys.
tactics: 641年諾真水之戰，李世勣分道出擊，先以輕騎誘敵、繼而以精騎掩殺其步卒，迫使大度設北走，薛延陀退回漠北。644至645年趁唐太宗東征高句麗，拔灼率騎兵深入陰山之南、攻唐之夏州，執失思力與田仁會設陷阱誘其來攻，擊而退之，拔灼旋即再至。646年正月太宗下詔分兵：朔、並、汾、箕、嵐、代、忻、蔚、雲九州兵鎮朔州，勝、夏、銀、綏、丹、延、鄜、坊、石、隰十州兵鎮勝州，靈、原、寧、鹽、慶五州兵鎮靈州，三處據點封住陰山各隘口；主力由李道宗、阿史那社爾率輕騎越陰山直趨薛延陀牙帳，執失思力、契苾何力取涼州方向斷其側翼，張儉與薛萬徹當正面。全戰役以招撫為先、討伐為備：郁督軍山一役李世勣先諭「降則撫之，叛則討之」，降而復叛，遂縱兵追擊；沙場上雙方都靠騎兵換馬續戰，唐軍則以弩陣壓制騎兵衝鋒，再以長槊與步兵結陣守住據點。
tacticsEn: At the Nozhenshui in 641 Li Shiji attacked in several columns, first screening the enemy with light cavalry and then falling on his foot with massed horsemen, which forced Dadu She to flee north and drove Xueyantuo back into the northern steppe. In 644 and 645, while Taizong was away in the east against Goguryeo, Ba Zhuo led riders south of the Yin Mountains to strike the Tang at Xiazhou; Zhishi Siri and Tian Renhui laid a trap, lured him into the assault and beat him back, and he returned at once to try again. In the first month of 646 the emperor issued the order to divide the army: troops of the circuits of Shuo, Bing, Fen, Ji, Lan, Dai, Xin, Wei and Yun to hold Shuozhou; troops of Sheng, Xia, Yin, Sui, Dan, Yan, Fu, Fang, Shi and Xi to hold Shengzhou; troops of Ling, Yuan, Ning, Yan and Qing to hold Lingzhou — three anchor points sealing the passes of the Yin Mountains. The main force under Li Daozong and Ashina She'er rode light cavalry over the Yin Mountains straight for the Xueyantuo camp, Zhishi Siri and Qibi Heli took the Liangzhou flank to cut the enemy's side, while Zhang Jian and Xue Wanche faced them frontally. Throughout, pacification came first and chastisement second: at the Yudu Jun Mountains Li Shiji first proclaimed that those who surrender be pacified and those who rebel be punished, and only when the surrendering tribes wavered did he let his men pursue. On the field both sides fought mounted and kept fighting by changing horses; the Tang answered cavalry charges with crossbow volleys, holding their posts with spears and close-order foot.
data: 可考的數字集中在編制與戰果兩端。646年正月太宗下詔，朔州一路出朔、並、汾、箕、嵐、代、忻、蔚、雲九州兵，勝州一路出勝、夏、銀、綏、丹、延、鄜、坊、石、隰十州兵，靈州一路出靈、原、寧、鹽、慶五州兵，合計二十三州之兵分屯三處重鎮。聘禮方面，643年薛延陀遣突利進貢馬五萬匹、牛一萬頭、羊十萬隻；642年泥熟又曾進馬匹、裘衣與琥珀鏡。646年七月李世勣討咄摩支於郁督軍山，前後斬首五千餘級，俘其部眾三萬餘人；咄摩支同月至京師長安，受拜右武衛大將軍。時間上，自641年諾真水交兵到646年七月薛延陀亡國，前後約五年。雙方兵力總數史籍多闕，只留下各道兵與州兵的名目與上述斬獲俘數。
dataEn: The numbers that survive concern organisation and results. In the first month of 646 the emperor ordered troops of nine circuits — Shuo, Bing, Fen, Ji, Lan, Dai, Xin, Wei and Yun — to Shuozhou, troops of ten circuits — Sheng, Xia, Yin, Sui, Dan, Yan, Fu, Fang, Shi and Xi — to Shengzhou, and troops of five circuits — Ling, Yuan, Ning, Yan and Qing — to Lingzhou: twenty-three circuits of troops posted in three strategic towns. On the marriage side, in 643 the Xueyantuo sent Tuli with fifty thousand horses, ten thousand oxen and a hundred thousand sheep as betrothal gifts, and in 642 Nishu had already offered horses, furs and a mirror of amber. In July 646 Li Shiji campaigned against Duomozhi at the Yudu Jun Mountains, cutting off more than five thousand by the head and taking over thirty thousand of the tribal people; Duomozhi reached the capital of Chang'an in the same month and was appointed Commander of the Right Imperial Guard. In time, from the clash at Nozhenshui in 641 to the fall of Xueyantuo in July 646, the business took about five years. Total strengths on both sides are largely unrecorded, leaving only the names of the columns and circuits and the casualty and captive figures quoted above.
cause: 戰爭的根子是唐與薛延陀都想按自己的方式安排漠北。630年李靖滅東突厥之後，漠北出現權力真空，薛延陀接收帳下與牧地而成為草原霸主，卻仍只是唐的藩屬；唐太宗要重建漠南屏障，於639年冊封阿史那思摩於定襄，把忠於唐的東突厥貴族放在薛延陀與唐之間。641年唐太宗將封禪泰山，薛延陀判斷唐主力東調，遂遣其子大度設猛攻阿史那思摩，兩軍交鋒於諾真水，唐軍取勝並責問真珠可汗，太宗本欲窮討，經魏徵進諫才罷兵，裂痕就此留下。642至643年雙方議和親，唐朝以聘禮未足為由反悔收回成命，又屢以宗室女下嫁羈縻之策對付塞外，被真珠可汗一眼看破。644年後阿史那思摩在漠南崩潰、退回中原，645年高句麗遣使求助薛延陀，真珠可汗畏唐拒之；同年真珠可汗病卒，拔灼即位改弦更張，見唐主力東征、邊防空虛，遂舉兵來犯，戰爭遂成定局。
causeEn: The root of the war was that Tang and Xueyantuo both wanted to arrange the northern steppe in their own fashion. After Li Jing destroyed the Eastern Turks in 630 a power vacuum opened in the steppe, and Xueyantuo absorbed the defeated tribes and their pastures to become the dominant steppe power, yet it remained only a vassal of Tang. Taizong wished to rebuild a buffer in the southern steppe, so in 639 he invested Ashina Simo at Dingxiang, placing a Turkic noble loyal to Tang between Xueyantuo and Tang himself. In 641, with Taizong about to perform the Fengshan sacrifice at Mount Tai, Xueyantuo judged that the Tang main force would be drawn east and sent his son Dadu She to strike Ashina Simo hard. The two armies met at Nozhenshui, the Tang won, and the emperor upbraided Zhenzhu Khagan; he wanted to press the attack to the bitter end and was held back by Wei Zheng, and the breach dated from that moment. Between 642 and 643 the two sides discussed a marriage alliance, only for Tang to withdraw the promise on the grounds that the betrothal gifts fell short, while repeatedly using a Tang princess as a hostage bride for the steppe — a stratagem Zhenzhu Khagan saw through at a glance. After 644 Ashina Simo's regime in the southern steppe collapsed and he withdrew to the interior, and in 645 Goguryeo sent envoys to seek Xueyantuo's help, which the now fearful Zhenzhu Khagan refused. That same year Zhenzhu Khagan died of illness; Ba Zhuo succeeded him, changed policy, saw the Tang main force away in the east and the borders empty, and struck. The war was decided.
impact: 薛延陀汗國覆亡，鐵勒諸部在漠北的聯盟結構解體。拔灼死後餘部或降或散，咄摩支以伊特勿失可汗名號收攏殘眾，得到唐軍追擊而終於出降；唐廷隨後在漠北與漠南陸續安置其餘部，編為州縣，酋長授都督，部眾內徙，鐵勒諸部從此大量成為唐的編戶與軍鎮來源，而回紇則趁勢取代薛延陀成為鐵勒盟主，藥羅葛吐迷度開創的部族此後數十年是唐在漠北的實際支柱。對唐而言，此役是自630年滅東突厥、657年滅西突厥三步中的一環，唐由此取得漠北的宗主權與絲路北道的護衛，農耕與遊牧的邊界再向北推移；對後世而言，唐廷以羈縻冊封加郡縣安置的做法，成為處理降附部族的長期模板，而薛延陀的崩潰亦顯示單憑冊封與互市無法約束草原政權，北方邊患並未因此根除。
impactEn: With the fall of the Xueyantuo Khanate the confederacy structure of the Tiele tribes on the northern steppe came apart. After Ba Zhuo's death the survivors either surrendered or scattered; Duomozhi gathered the remnants under the title of Yite Wushi Khagan, was pursued by Tang columns and finally gave himself up. The Tang court thereafter settled the remaining tribes in the steppe and on its northern frontier, registering them as prefectures and counties, granting the chiefs the rank of commandant and moving the people into the interior, so that from then on the Tiele supplied large numbers of registered households and of garrison troops to the empire. In their place the Uighur rose as the leading power of the Tiele, and the state founded by Yiluoge Tumidu would stand for decades as Tang's real pillar on the northern steppe. For Tang this campaign was one of three steps that began with the destruction of the Eastern Turks in 630 and ended with that of the Western Turks in 657; it brought the empire the overlordship of the northern steppe and the protection of the northern branch of the silk road, pushing the frontier between settled and nomadic lands further north. For posterity the Tang practice of combining investiture and pacification with the enrolment of surrendered tribes into prefectures became the long-term template for handling surrendered peoples, while the collapse of Xueyantuo also demonstrated that investiture and trade alone could not restrain a steppe power: the northern frontier trouble was not thereby ended.
result: 646年春天，執失思力與喬師望合兵追擊拔灼，拔灼逃入阿史德部落，被回紇攻殺，屍身與王族遭到搜捕，薛延陀本部陷入混亂。唐太宗隨即以李道宗、阿史那社爾為瀚海安撫大使，發兵大舉進攻，執失思力將突厥兵、契苾何力將涼州及胡兵、薛萬徹與張儉各將所部，分道並進。餘眾推咄摩支為伊特勿失可汗，李世勣進軍郁督軍山，遣蕭嗣業往招；咄摩支先南奔荒谷，終於歸降，唐軍仍縱兵追擊，前後斬首五千餘級、俘其部眾三萬餘人。七月，咄摩支至京師長安，拜右武衛大將軍，薛延陀汗國正式滅亡。餘部此後數年仍零星起兵反覆，直到唐廷完成州縣編置才逐漸安定；漠北第一次出現由唐直接經營的邊防體系，而草原政權留下的空白隨即被回紇填補。
resultEn: In the spring of 646 Zhishi Siri and Qiao Shiwang closed in on Ba Zhuo, who fled to the Ashide tribe and was killed in an attack by the Uighur, his body and the royal clan hunted down, and the main body of Xueyantuo fell into confusion. Taizong at once appointed Li Daozong and Ashina She'er Pacification Commissioners for the Hanhai and launched a general offensive, Zhishi Siri taking the Turkic troops, Qibi Heli the Liangzhou and Hu troops, and Xue Wanche and Zhang Jian their own contingents, advancing by several routes at once. The survivors set up Duomozhi as Yite Wushi Khagan; Li Shiji marched to the Yudu Jun Mountains and sent Xiao Siye to make overtures. Duomozhi first fled south into the wild valleys and finally surrendered, yet the Tang still sent the cavalry in pursuit, cutting off more than five thousand by the head and taking over thirty thousand of the tribal people. In July Duomozhi reached the capital of Chang'an and was appointed Commander of the Right Imperial Guard, and the Xueyantuo Khanate was formally extinguished. The remnants rose in scattered revolt for several more years and were only gradually settled once the Tang had completed the enrolment of the prefectures and counties; for the first time a frontier system directly administered by Tang appeared in the northern steppe, while the vacuum left by the steppe state was promptly filled by the Uighur.
